title: AARO Releases FY2025 Annual UAP Report Months Late — 319 New Cases, 205 Unresolved
detail: The Pentagon's All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO) publicly released its Fiscal Year 2025 Consolidated Annual Report on UAP, covering June 2, 2024 through May 30, 2025 — arriving well after the statutory reporting deadline established by Congress. AARO received 319 new UAP reports (284 from the reporting period, 35 backlogged from 2010-2024) and resolved 114 of them, leaving 205 unresolved; it also closed out 256 previously unresolved cases from earlier years, including 238 attributed to a newly expanded capability for identifying satellite-reflection ('satellite flare') false positives. Of the incidents, 274 occurred in the air domain, 44 in space, and 1 in the maritime domain. Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand called the report 'another crucial step forward in our understanding of UAPs and toward the transparency that the American people deserve.'
confidenceReason: Official AARO/DoD annual report to Congress, corroborated by a sitting senator's official press statement and independent FOIA-focused reporting.

title: AARO Report Discloses Navy-Reported Swarm of ~100 UAP Off Virginia Coast
detail: Within its FY2025 annual report, AARO disclosed the fiscal year's sole maritime-domain UAP case: a U.S. Navy report describing roughly 100 unidentified airborne objects and two likely uncrewed surface systems operating near Virginia's coast. AARO said it is 'actively investigating this event in coordination with the reporting unit' but did not provide the specific date of the underlying sighting. The office noted that 'a lack of timely and actionable sensor data continues to constrain' its investigative capability for incidents like this one, which drew attention as the largest single object count described in the report and occurred near sensitive military installations.
confidenceReason: Disclosed via official AARO annual report and confirmed by AARO statement to press; precise sighting date and full sensor corroboration not yet public.
